g.text: Curator Go build driver — safe install lifecycle
No project, key, or manager-home lock is created.
Parse schema v6 and validate build roots
Compute build-source identity before cache lookup
Build closure, check collisions, and exclude build roots
Run skill check, system, MCP, audit, registry,
Create an operation-private probe and establish
Derive exact inputs and inspect the protected cache
No go list or go build.
No cache, marker, runtime, shim, adapter,
For every miss, run fixed go list and validate
Verify and hash each artifact and canonical receipt
Delete private staging and probe state
Previous install and live cache remain byte-for-byte intact.
Recover journals and revalidate cache boundary,
closure generations, owners, preimages, and keys
Discard stale staging and restart from
Atomically swap contexts, marker v2, runtime, shims,
env files, adapters, mirrors, and managed removals
Commit the machine-wide consumer ledger last
Keep the manager-home lock and restore journaled
Run locked runtime, snapshot, and build-cache GC
Release manager-home lock, then project lock(s)
